Agent Name: Planner

Reason for Mistake: In the final step (Step 3), the Planner incorrectly identified the movie title as "Authority" and claimed it was a 2008 *Law & Order: SVU* episode. This is factually wrong; the movie described in the search results is titled "Compliance" (2012). The Planner hallucinated the title "Authority" instead of using the correct information ("Compliance") that the WebSurfer had just successfully retrieved from the search results in the previous step.
